main.description: An independently published description of a versioning scheme. Projects may reference any publisher's scheme by URI and CID. Treat records as immutable; publish a new record when semantics change. Names are descriptive, not globally unique algorithm identifiers.

name.description: Human-readable name of the scheme, including its specification edition where applicable.

description.description: Summary of the scheme's syntax, ordering, and compatibility intent.

specification.description: Specification defining syntax, precedence, normalization, and compatibility semantics where applicable. Prefer a versioned or content-addressed URI. The scheme record's CID does not pin the contents of this external resource.
